title: Keycloak: Allocation of resources without limits or throttling (CWE-770) during Java object deserialization in Google…
description: A high-severity vulnerability in Keycloak versions prior to 26.8.1-r1 involves uncontrolled allocation of resources during Java object deserialization in Google Guava versions 4. This flaw can lead to resource exhaustion without limits or throttling, potentially impacting availability. The issue is tracked as CVE-2026-102554 and has a CVSS 4.0 base score of 8.2. A fix is available in Keycloak version 26.8.1-r1.
